excluded_boundaries.reason: Framewise speech/nonspeech activity is an input to a timer, never an utterance or turn boundary.
Typed silence/filler labels may drive playback budgeting; they do not decide that a turn has ended.
Transcript text can supply semantic context, but ASR segmentation alone is not a turn-completion result.
Detecting a filler or stutter is not detecting the end of a turn and must never gate or delete audio.
